Shift Left Complicates Fab Data Management

By Anne Meixner and Laura Peters - 08 Oct, 2026 - Comments: 0

Key Takeaways:

“Shift left” improves yield by moving detection earlier. Fabs are using real-time equipment sensor data and AI/ML to identify process excursions inside the process module and improve advanced process control.
Higher sampling rates, hundreds of sensor parameters, and sub-second analysis are increasing the volume, velocity, and variety of manufacturing data.
